title: The Green Road
summary: A five-chapter campaign brings new maps, wardens, challenges, and a journey to the Grime King's throne.
changes: Choose between the classic endless stand and the new five-chapter campaign.
Explore unique chapter maps with story-driven terrain, escalating threats, and rotating guardian and spell restrictions.
Face nineteen new campaign wardens before confronting the Grime King in the final chapter.
Resume campaign chapters across sessions and track each restored region on the Green Road.
Campaign chapters now end at wave 20 with bosses at waves 5, 10, 15, and 20.

title: Leaderboard restored
summary: Completed runs now appear correctly on the leaderboard.
changes: Fixed completed runs not appearing on the leaderboard.

title: A fresh leaderboard
summary: The leaderboard now keeps past runs while comparing scores under the latest rules.
changes: Past runs are preserved for future profile history.
Leaderboard scores now use the current ruleset.

title: A sharper last stand
summary: Guardian balance and onboarding received a round of polish.
changes: Boarstone attacks hit harder and cover more ground, but fire more slowly.
Selling a guardian now returns 75% of all gold invested.
Guardians can no longer be moved after they are planted.
The guided intro ends with a clear Got it action.
